//: W1-T2902: apps/dashboard could not load as shipped -- index.html's <script src="./main.js">
expected a compiled file BESIDE it, but the root tsconfig.json (outDir: dist, rootDir: .)
only ever emitted to dist/apps/dashboard/src/main.js, and nothing copied index.html there.
This package-local tsconfig is the 'a build that emits beside index.html' half of that fix
(the other half is index.html's own <script type="importmap"> for the bare
@remudero/api-client/client specifier, since a browser -- unlike tsx/Node -- cannot resolve
a package.json 'exports' map on its own). `rootDir` is the repo root because this package's
one real dependency, packages/api-client/src/client.ts, lives outside apps/dashboard/ -- the
narrowest rootDir TypeScript accepts is their common ancestor. `outDir: build` keeps the
compiled tree out of apps/dashboard/src (never mixed with hand-written sources) while still
landing everything UNDER apps/dashboard/, i.e. beside index.html, not in the monorepo's
shared dist/. See index.html's own script/importmap tags for the exact resulting paths.
